reviews.rationale: One exact source-word correction is required: the opening consider word shows an uncurled simple arch Lawe I after ወ, supporting ወለብዉ rather than candidate ወልብዉ. This was also my preliminary source-first reading. Compare opening.png against ለምድር in the same crop, then the explicitly distinct ለ and curled ል in the same-edition p72 ለ[14]መልአክ comparator and the headed Lawe table. Do not standardize the selected printed vowel from a morphological expectation. The final Wawe II tail remains and the English imperative “consider” can remain. The other 16 words, both stars and exact boundaries are supported on the complete selected scan and camera leaf. My early ይስተርኢ is corrected to ያስተርኢ: opening Yaman IV has left-only foot unlike the visibly right-spurred VI in ርእይዋ; the exact imperfect is also photographed in col298, with terminal Alf III. Completion ተፍጻሜቱ and its distinction from headword ተፍጻሜት are supported. Full English and all three notes are otherwise acceptable as qualified: note a discloses possible completion suffix without forced possessor; note b’s content connector, negative universal, suffix anticipation, and no inserted contrast are supported by photographed §§190.5,197(d),172(c) and selected apparatus13. Note c’s bracket preserves the circumstantial/appearance words without assigning a subject, and distinguishes uncertainty from a print gap; personally viewed §170.5 and col298, selected apparatus15–16, Flemming p2 and read the bound edited Aramaic/Greek comparison. No restoration or author-supported supersession of prior holds.
